description: This Python script provides a command-line tool for compressing images into various texture formats (PVRTC and ETC1), supporting different external tools and SDKs, with classes for handling specific compression methods.

classes.name: Tool
classes.description: Base class for texture compression tools, providing common methods for processing images, writing texture files, and running external commands.

classes.name: Etc1Tool
classes.description: Handles ETC1 texture compression, locating the 'etc1tool' external utility and executing the compression process.

classes.name: PvrtcTool
classes.description: Handles PVRTC texture compression, locating the 'texturetool' external utility and executing the compression process.

methods.name: Tool.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the Tool with options, setting source filename and destination directory.

methods.name: Tool.tex_fn
methods.description: Property that computes the output texture filename based on source filename and destination directory.

methods.name: Tool.compress
methods.description: Placeholder method for compressing textures, to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: Tool.nearest_pow2
methods.description: Calculates the nearest power of two greater than or equal to a given value.

methods.name: Tool.runcmd
methods.description: Runs an external command and waits for its completion.

methods.name: Tool.write_tex
methods.description: Writes the compressed texture data and metadata into a file with a specific header format.

methods.name: Tool.run
methods.description: Static method that parses command-line arguments and initiates the appropriate compression process.

methods.name: Etc1Tool.__init__
methods.description: Initializes ETC1 compression tool and locates the 'etc1tool' utility.

methods.name: Etc1Tool.locate_etc1tool
methods.description: Searches system paths and environment variables to find the 'etc1tool' executable.

methods.name: Etc1Tool.compress
methods.description: Performs ETC1 compression by resizing the image, invoking 'etc1tool', and writing the output.

methods.name: PvrtcTool.__init__
methods.description: Initializes PVRTC compression tool and locates the 'texturetool' utility.

methods.name: PvrtcTool.locate_texturetool
methods.description: Searches system paths and environment variables to find the 'texturetool' executable.

methods.name: PvrtcTool.compress
methods.description: Performs PVRTC compression by resizing the image, invoking 'texturetool', and writing the output.
